title: Add 3D rotating background with continuously changing camera angles

requirements.summary: Replace the current animated gradient background with a Three.js 3D scene that continuously rotates and changes camera angles to create a calming, unique visual effect
acceptanceCriteria: 3D scene replaces the existing animated gradient background on LoginScreen
Camera continuously rotates around the 3D object with smooth, calming motion
Camera angles change dynamically to create visual interest
Animation is smooth and does not impact application performance
3D scene works in both light and dark themes

file_operations.description: Create a new React component that renders a React Three Fiber Canvas with a 3D rotating scene. This component will encapsulate the entire 3D background logic including the Canvas setup, scene configuration, and will be positioned to fill the background area. The component should accept theme-aware props to adapt colors based on light/dark mode.

Replace the existing animated gradient background with the new ThreeBackground component. Remove CSS-based gradient animation classes and integrate the ThreeBackground component as a full-screen background layer positioned absolutely behind the login content. Ensure the ThreeBackground component receives the current theme state to adapt its colors appropriately.

Remove or comment out the existing @keyframes gradient-rotate animation and any related background-animation classes that are no longer needed after replacing with the 3D scene. Preserve all other OKLCH theme variables and global styles as they will be used by the 3D scene for color theming.

requirements.summary: Implement the 3D scene using React Three Fiber with an abstract geometric shape that serves as the focal point for the rotating camera
acceptanceCriteria: React Three Fiber Canvas component is integrated into LoginScreen.tsx
3D geometry is abstract and visually interesting
Lighting setup enhances the calming effect
Scene renders efficiently without blocking UI interactions

file_operations.description: Create a Scene3D component that contains the 3D geometry, lighting, and materials for the rotating background. This component should render an abstract geometric shape (such as a torus knot, icosahedron with subdivisions, or custom geometry) with appropriate materials. Add ambient and directional lighting to create depth and enhance the calming visual effect. The geometry and materials should accept color props derived from OKLCH theme variables.

Import and integrate the Scene3D component within the Canvas. Configure Canvas props for optimal performance including gl settings, dpr (device pixel ratio), and frameloop settings. Position the Canvas to cover the full background area without interfering with UI interactions by ensuring pointer-events are properly configured.

requirements.summary: Configure camera animation to rotate continuously with varying speeds and angles to create a unique, mesmerizing effect that never repeats exactly
acceptanceCriteria: Camera position changes smoothly over time
Rotation speeds vary subtly to avoid monotony
Camera always keeps the 3D object in view
Animation loop is seamless with no jarring transitions

file_operations.description: Create a CameraController component using React Three Fiber's useFrame hook to animate the camera position and rotation continuously. Implement smooth orbital motion using trigonometric functions with varying speeds (e.g., sine and cosine with different frequencies) to create non-repeating patterns. Use lookAt to ensure the camera always focuses on the 3D object. Add subtle variations in radius, elevation angles, and rotation speeds to create the mesmerizing, calming effect requested.

Import and add the CameraController component inside the Canvas. Ensure the CameraController is properly positioned in the scene hierarchy so it can access and control the default camera or a custom PerspectiveCamera. Configure initial camera position and field of view for optimal viewing of the 3D scene.

requirements.summary: Ensure the 3D background maintains visual harmony with the existing OKLCH color system and adapts to light/dark theme changes
acceptanceCriteria: 3D scene colors are derived from the existing OKLCH theme variables
Material colors adjust appropriately when theme is toggled
3D background does not clash with foreground UI elements
Scene maintains adequate contrast for text readability

file_operations.description: Create a custom React hook that reads OKLCH CSS custom properties from the document root and converts them to RGB or hex color values compatible with Three.js materials. This hook should monitor theme changes and return color values for primary, secondary, background, and accent colors. Use getComputedStyle to extract CSS variables and parse OKLCH values into formats Three.js can consume.

Use the useThemeColors hook to obtain theme-aware colors and apply them to the 3D geometry materials, lights, and fog (if used). Ensure material colors update reactively when the theme changes. Configure material properties (such as opacity, metalness, roughness) to ensure the 3D background remains subtle and does not overpower foreground UI elements. Test color combinations to maintain adequate contrast for text readability in both light and dark themes.

Pass theme context or theme colors as props to Scene3D and CameraController if needed. Ensure the Canvas background color or fog color adapts to the current theme using OKLCH-derived colors. Add CSS styling to ensure the Canvas is properly layered behind the login content with appropriate z-index and pointer-events settings to prevent interaction conflicts.
